instruction: Please add this webpage I have open to my bookmarks bar.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding the open webpage (Illustrated Transformer) to bookmarks bar. Uses existing is_expected_bookmarks metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction is semantically ambiguous: 'this webpage I have open' does not specify which webpage when 2 tabs are opened (eleuther.ai and jalammar.github.io)
Expected value hardcodes a specific URL (jalammar.github.io) without the instruction specifying which of the 2 opened webpages should be bookmarked
Evaluator will incorrectly fail if agent bookmarks the eleuther.ai page instead, even though the instruction 'add this webpage' is equally satisfied by bookmarking either tab
Incomplete requirement specification: instruction should either specify the active tab or ensure only one tab is open to be unambiguous
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix instruction to be specific: 'Please add the Illustrated Transformer webpage (https://jalammar.github.io/illustrated-transformer/) to my bookmarks bar' OR 'Please add the currently active tab to my bookmarks bar'
Alternative: modify config to open only ONE tab so 'this webpage' is unambiguous
Alternative: add a config step to activate a specific tab before the agent starts, then instruction can use 'this webpage' or 'the active tab'
Expected value should match whatever the instruction actually requires - if instruction is fixed to specify jalammar.github.io, current expected is correct
